slides.headline: The War That Outgrew Its Targets
slides.subheadline: Nuclear talks gave way to strikes, maritime blockades and global economic disruption.
slides.svgBlueprint: Use viewBox='0 0 540 960' with 36px safe margins. White paper, black typography, red accents and pale-gray surfaces throughout the series. Place publication masthead at y=44, red kicker at y=108, and a 68px bold grotesk headline across four manually wrapped lines. Position the 24px subheadline beneath. One interrupted red circle anchors the lower third. Stack two compact telemetry lines above the issue badge. No cards, arrows, maps or diagrams. Keep citations as readable source markers; never shrink body copy to accommodate them.

slides.headline: Diplomacy Under a Gathering Arsenal
slides.subheadline: The military buildup accelerated while nuclear negotiations remained underway.

cards.title: The preceding war
cards.body: Israel’s Operation Rising Lion preceded the new campaign during the Twelve-Day War.

cards.title: The buildup
cards.body: Washington assembled its largest regional military buildup since the 2003 invasion of Iraq.

cards.title: The rupture
cards.body: Hundreds of US–Israeli air strikes began during ongoing nuclear negotiations.

slides.svgBlueprint: Maintain the cover palette and 540×960 canvas. Set a 46px headline above three ascending platforms, read chronologically from bottom-left to top-right. Place June 2025 at y=710, the buildup at y=530, and opening strikes at y=350. Integrate each telemetry badge directly into its corresponding platform rather than adding another dashboard. Use black hairline steps and a red terminal marker. Bodies use 22px text, maximum four lines, with generous separation.

slides.headline: Three Codenames, One Expanding War
slides.subheadline: Leadership strikes triggered retaliation against Israel, US bases and regional allies.

cards.title: Operation Epic Fury
cards.body: Washington’s opening campaign joined Israeli attacks; the combined assault killed Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei.

cards.title: Operation Roaring Lion
cards.body: Israel’s opening campaign followed Operation Rising Lion during the Twelve-Day War.

cards.title: Operation True Promise IV
cards.body: Iran answered with missiles, drones and a blockade of the Strait of Hormuz.

slides.svgBlueprint: Use a 540×960 white canvas and 36px margins. Under the headline, place a wide black Epic Fury card with white text, a narrower pale-gray Roaring Lion card offset right, and a full-width outlined True Promise IV card. Mark the response with a red left rule, not an explosion icon. Titles use 27px type and bodies 22px. Keep cards vertically separated and non-overlapping. Position the two date badges in a restrained footer strip.

slides.headline: The Threat Had Competing Timelines
slides.subheadline: Presidential warnings and intelligence assessments addressed different horizons of missile development.

cards.title: Trump’s warning
cards.body: Trump said Iran was developing US-reaching missiles and had restarted its supposedly “obliterated” nuclear program.

cards.title: The intelligence horizon
cards.body: A cited US intelligence assessment placed development of missiles capable of striking America at 2035.

slides.svgBlueprint: Below the headline band, divide the 540×960 canvas into two tall columns separated by a red 2px rule. Use white on the left and pale gray on the right, with black text throughout. Anchor February 2026 and 2035 at matching heights in 34px type. Place each corresponding claim beneath its badge in 22px manually wrapped text. Leave substantial empty space below. Do not draw a proportional timeline or imply a quantified probability.

slides.headline: Destruction Is Not Nuclear Verification
slides.subheadline: Restricted access left inspectors unable to establish enrichment status or stockpile whereabouts.

cards.title: Safeguards breached
cards.body: The IAEA Board found Iran non-compliant with its safeguards obligations.

cards.title: Iran’s objection
cards.body: Iran called normal safeguards implementation “legally untenable and materially impracticable,” citing attacks and continuing threats.

cards.title: Inspectors’ limit
cards.body: The IAEA could not verify enrichment suspension or current uranium stocks; safeguards obligations remained binding.

slides.svgBlueprint: Create three spacious ledger rows beneath a 46px headline on the standard 540×960 canvas. Each row contains its date badge, a 27px institutional heading and a 22px body. Use black horizontal rules and pale-gray alternate row backgrounds. A narrow red margin rule marks unresolved verification, without suggesting a weapons finding. Keep all three dates attached to their corresponding rows. Use no checkmarks: uncertainty must not resemble certification.

slides.headline: A Ceasefire Without Regional Peace
slides.subheadline: Lebanon fighting and competing maritime restrictions undermined the diplomatic pause.

cards.title: Two-week ceasefire
cards.body: Israeli airstrikes across Lebanon immediately strained the initial two-week truce.

cards.title: Islamabad fails
cards.body: Failed negotiations were followed by a US naval blockade on Iran.

cards.title: Washington extends
cards.body: The United States announced an indefinite ceasefire; regional peace remained elusive.

slides.svgBlueprint: Run a thin black vertical spine at x=58 from y=310 to y=795 on a 540×960 white canvas. Place three red circular nodes in chronological order, with integrated date badges and body text to their right. Interrupt the spine with small white gaps after each milestone to suggest discontinuity, not measured duration. Use 30px date typography, 25px titles and 22px bodies. Keep a clear source footer and avoid additional callout boxes.

slides.headline: Signatures Could Not Secure the Strait
slides.subheadline: A war-ending memorandum failed to deliver durable passage through Hormuz.

cards.title: A memorandum signed
cards.body: Washington and Tehran signed a memorandum intended to end the war and lift their dual blockade.

cards.title: A ceasefire resumed
cards.body: After renewed tension, the United States and Iran agreed to resume the ceasefire.

cards.title: The agreement breaks
cards.body: The ceasefire collapsed amid Iranian attacks on commercial vessels in the Strait of Hormuz.

slides.svgBlueprint: Use the shared 540×960 canvas but invert the composition: place the timeline spine at x=475 and align text blocks left. Integrate each date above its corresponding card. Render the first two nodes as black outlined squares; use a solid red square for 8 July. Break the connector before the final node. Preserve white paper and pale-gray document panels. Dates use 32px, titles 26px and bodies 22px. No decorative signatures or implied legal seals.

slides.headline: The Shock Travelled Beyond Oil
slides.subheadline: Disrupted shipping transmitted pressure through energy, fertilizer, transport and household budgets.

cards.title: Energy exposure
cards.body: Hormuz carried 25 per cent of global seaborne oil trade in 2024.

cards.title: Agriculture exposure
cards.body: Persian Gulf seaborne fertilizer shipments totalled 16 million tonnes in 2024, exposing agriculture to disruption.

telemetry.label: Global seaborne oil trade through Hormuz, 2024

slides.svgBlueprint: Create two vertically staggered exposure cards on the standard 540×960 canvas. The upper white card uses a large black oil-trade figure; the lower pale-gray card uses a red fertilizer-shipment figure. Place 2024 baseline labels directly beneath both metrics so neither reads as a wartime loss. Integrate card copy below each badge. Use 44px metric type with deliberate wrapping, 22px bodies and thin black borders. Avoid proportional bars because the units differ.

slides.headline: The Bill Was Not the Cost
slides.subheadline: The Pentagon’s estimate excluded damage to US bases in the Middle East.

cards.title: Military accounting
cards.body: The estimate covered US war spending, not a separately itemized opening-operation budget.

cards.title: Costs beyond the ledger
cards.body: Base damage remained excluded; global energy, transport and household pressures lay beyond the military tally.​

telemetry.label: Accounting cutoff in the October 28, 2026 report

slides.svgBlueprint: On the shared 540×960 canvas, make the spending estimate the dominant element: '$47.1' in 108px black type with 'billion' immediately beneath in 52px. Keep the exact combined value legible. Place an outlined Oct. 16 cutoff badge below, explicitly labelled as 2026 accounting. Stack two pale-gray footnote cards in the lower third with 22px bodies. A red underline emphasizes 'estimate'. Do not use a pie chart or imply a complete economic total.

slides.headline: Peace Must Be Verified, Not Declared
slides.subheadline: Judge settlement by nuclear access, navigable seas and an end to regional fighting.

cards.title: Verify the nuclear position
cards.body: Require inspector access and material accounting; destroyed facilities cannot certify the disappearance of nuclear capability.

cards.title: Secure commercial passage
cards.body: Judge ceasefires by safe navigation and regional restraint, not signatures alone.​

cards.title: Count the wider burden
cards.body: Keep military spending separate from omitted base damage and global economic consequences.​

telemetry.label: Incomplete US cost estimate through Oct. 16
